lines.t: O you of little faith, how long?
Where is your trust?
I am in the boat with you.
Look at Me.
Salt on your tongue, rain in your eyes,
The boat keeps taking on the sea.
You count the waves as they rise and rise.
When did you stop counting on Me?
I know the ache of a hungry body.
I know what it costs to say, “Thy will.”
I slept with My head on a cushion,
Then stood and told the sea, “Be still.”
Hear My voice above the water.
See the hand you thought you'd lost.
You don't have to still your trembling.
You do have to take My hand.
O you of little faith, how long?
Where is your trust? Where is your trust?
How long will the storm tell you who you are?
The sea obeys Me. Will you?
Put your foot where My promise is.
Put your weight on what I've said.
Don't wait for the fear to leave you.
Take Me at My word instead.
Touch Me and see. These are the hands
That broke the bread and bore the nails.
Smell the woodsmoke on the shore.
Taste the fish while the night turns pale.
I did not leave you to the grave.
I did not rise to watch you drown.
Beloved, lift your eyes and look:
The One who holds the stars has stooped down.
Take a mustard seed between your fingers.
Who wrote the branches in that grain?
It sees the branches folded in it
Before a bird has come to land.
The dark says, “This is where you end.”
The root goes on beneath the stone.
You call yourself the dirt that holds you.
I know the shade where birds will sing.
O you of little faith, how long?
Where is your trust? Where is your trust?
How long will the storm tell you who you are?
The sea obeys Me. Will you?
Put your foot where My promise is.
Put your weight on what I've said.
Don't wait for the fear to leave you.
Take Me at My word instead.
Look now. There you are in Zion.
Hear your own voice in the song.
Cool river water round your ankles.
The last tear dried. The old shame gone.
See your face there in the water:
Not a stranger. You, made whole.
You call that morning far away.
I spoke it first. It shall not fail.
Even from the beginning,
It was decided and accomplished...
Now lay hold of that morning.
Pull it into what you do today.
Make the call. Tell the truth.
Forgive the debt you still rehearse.
Keep My words when no one sees you.
Let tomorrow catch you already walking.
O you of little faith, how long?
Where is your trust? Where is your trust?
The wind may rise before the dawn.
The sea obeys Me. Will you?
Put your foot where My promise is.
Put your weight on what I've said.
Bring that morning here by faith.
Walk in it before it breaks.
Your foot can shake.
Put it down.
I am here.
